extracted.intended_audience: Researchers preparing NIH PHS 398 / PHS 2590 grant applications (PD/PIs and senior/key personnel)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for completing the PHS 398 'Other Support' sections and the Research & Related Budget (sections A–K) for NIH new, renewal, and non‑competing progress report applications, including required fields, effort measurement, formatting, and disclosure of overlap.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide active and pending support for all senior/key personnel
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide active and pending support for all senior/key personnel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Other Support includes all financial resources, whether Federal, non-Federal, commercial or institutional, available in direct support of an individual's research endeavors, including but not limited to research grants, cooperative agreements, contracts, and/or institutional awards. Training awards, prizes, or gifts do not need to be included. There is no 'form page' for other support; information should be provided in the format shown, using continuation pages as necessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of items to include as Other Support
rubrics_metrics.description: Include all financial resources available in direct support of the individual's research endeavors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicitly includes Federal, non-Federal, commercial, or institutional resources such as research grants, cooperative agreements, contracts, and institutional awards. Excludes training awards, prizes, or gifts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Measure and report effort in person months
rubrics_metrics.description: Effort devoted to projects must be measured using person months.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate calendar, academic, and/or summer months associated with each project (e.g., person months: Cal/Academic/Summer). This applies to Other Support and Research & Related budget entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Support required fields / sample format
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the sample format to report each Other Support entry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Format fields shown: NAME OF INDIVIDUAL; ACTIVE/PENDING; Project Number (Principal Investigator); Source; Title of Project (or Subproject) with 'The major goals of this project are…'; Dates of Approved/Proposed Project; Annual Direct Costs; Person Months (Cal/Academic/Summer). Include OVERLAP (summarized for each individual). Include the principal investigator's name at the top and number consecutively with the rest of the application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure of overlap/overcommitment
rubrics_metrics.description: Summarize overlap for each individual; state 'None' if there is no overlap.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each individual list overlaps explicitly under OVERLAP and summarize overlap/overcommitment as appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non‑competing progress reports (PHS 2590) support reporting rule
rubrics_metrics.description: For Non-competing Progress Reports (PHS 2590) submit only active support for key personnel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The instruction distinguishes PHS 398 (New and Renewal) vs PHS 2590 (Non‑competing Progress Reports) and limits reporting to active support for key personnel on PHS 2590.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organizational DUNS required
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the organization's DUNS number in the Research & Related Budget header.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organizational DUNS* field appears in each Budget Period header and must be completed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specify budget type (Project vs Subaward/Consortium)
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether the budget is for the Project or a Subaward/Consortium.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Budget Type*: ● Project ❍ Subaward/Consortium — select the appropriate option for each budget period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget period start and end dates
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide Start Date and End Date for each Budget Period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each Research & Related Budget section requires Start Date* and End Date* for the Budget Period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Senior/Key Person required fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Report detailed information for each Senior/Key Person.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fields required: Prefix, First Name, Middle Name, Last Name, Suffix, Project Role*, Base Salary ($), Calendar Months, Academic Months, Summer Months, Requested Salary ($)*, Fringe Benefits ($)*, Funds Requested ($)*. Provide total funds requested for all Senior/Key Persons in the attached file and include additional Senior Key Persons file names if used.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Personnel reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: List other personnel with counts and financials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report Number of Personnel, Project Role, Calendar Months, Academic Months, Summer Months, Requested Salary ($)*, Fringe Benefits*, Funds Requested ($)*. Breakouts suggested: Post Doctoral Associates, Graduate Students, Undergraduate Students, Secretarial/Clerical. Provide Total Number Other Personnel and Total Other Personnel funds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equipment reporting threshold
rubrics_metrics.description: List equipment items exceeding $5,000.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Equipment Description: List items and dollar amount for each item exceeding $5,000. Provide Total funds requested for all equipment listed in the attached file.

rubrics_metrics.name: Travel costs categories
rubrics_metrics.description: Report domestic and foreign travel costs separately.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Travel: 1. Domestic Travel Costs (Incl. Canada, Mexico, and U.S. Possessions); 2. Foreign Travel Costs. Provide totals for Travel Cost.

rubrics_metrics.name: Participant / Trainee Support Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide detailed participant/trainee support cost categories and counts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include Tuition/Fees/Health Insurance, Stipends, Travel, Subsistence, Other; report Number of Participants/Trainees and Total Participant Trainee Support Costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Direct Costs categories
rubrics_metrics.description: Report other direct costs using specified line items.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Other Direct Costs (F): 1. Materials and Supplies; 2. Publication Costs; 3. Consultant Services; 4. ADP/Computer Services; 5. Subawards/Consortium/Contractual Costs; 6. Equipment or Facility Rental/User Fees; 7. Alterations and Renovations. Provide Total Other Direct Costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct costs and total direct costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Calculate and report Direct Costs (A thru F) and Total Direct Costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Section G requires the Funds Requested ($) for Total Direct Costs, summing A through F.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indirect costs reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide indirect cost type, rate, base, and funds requested, plus cognizant agency POC.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report Indirect Cost Type, Indirect Cost Rate (%), Indirect Cost Base ($), and Funds Requested ($)*. Include Cognizant Federal Agency (Agency Name, POC Name, and POC Phone Number).

rubrics_metrics.name: Total direct and indirect costs (and fee)
rubrics_metrics.description: Report combined totals and fee if any.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Section I: Total Direct and Indirect Costs (G + H). Section J: Fee — report Funds Requested ($)* (example shows 0.00).

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification file rule
rubrics_metrics.description: Attach Budget Justification as a single file.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: K. Budget Justification* File Name: BUDGET_JUSTIFICATION_... . Mime Type: application/pdf (Only attach one file.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Use provided sample as guidance and see Supplemental Instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: The sample is intended to provide guidance regarding the type and extent of information requested.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For instructions and information pertaining to the use of and policy for other support, see Other Support in the Supplemental Instructions, Part III, Policies, Assurances, Definitions, and Other Information.
